mechanism: closed-bar re-entry after an extreme volatility-band excursion, conditioned on non-trending regime and normalized reversal evidence
payer_or_constraint: temporary liquidity/positioning overshoot; not unconditional band-touch mean reversion
implementation_lessons: require excursion then re-entry transition, not a static band touch
strong trend is a no-trade state
mean target, structural stop, timeout and cost budget are policy-owned

sources.use: intraday mean-reversion architecture evidence; not Bollinger parameter authority

falsification: reject if re-entry events do not beat matched controls after frozen costs, or if gains exist only during strong-trend states that the preregistered policy vetoes
